features.name: MCP Server for Business Central
features.description: An MCP server that exposes all built-in APIs for data and allows custom APIs to be added, enabling agents to interact with Business Central through an MCP connector.
features.status_evidence_quote: It's currently in public preview. So go to um feature management and enable that.
caveats: Custom APIs can be added with preview version
May open up for API queries in the future

features.name: Default Configuration Mode
features.description: MCP configuration that provides three dynamic tools available: action search, describe, and invoke, allowing agents to discover and call tools without pre-loading the full tool list.
caveats: Limited to three tools: search, describe, invoke

features.name: Named Configurations
features.description: Specific MCP configurations that pre-load explicit tool lists for targeted business processes, eliminating the need for tool search and enabling direct tool access by the language model.
caveats: Can fill up model context if too many tools are included

features.name: Dynamic Tools System with Semantic Search
features.description: System where MCP client passes keywords to BC actions search tool, performs semantic search to find top relevant tools, then language model calls describe and invoke to interact with API pages using OData protocol.
caveats: Limited by maximum tool support of different MCP hosts

features.name: About Text for API Pages
features.description: Metadata property added to API pages that provides descriptive text to help agents reason better over what APIs are able to do, allowing specific and detailed descriptions to guide language models.
caveats: Requires manual creation or AI assistance for generation

features.name: API Page Tool Naming Convention
features.description: Tool names include object type and ID appended for uniqueness, with descriptive action text, description, and about text to guide language models in understanding tool capabilities.
caveats: Must maintain unique names across tool list

features.name: Discover Additional Objects Feature
features.description: Setting that enables discovery of readonly API pages beyond a core set, providing agents with broader data access but potentially increasing confusion and consuming model context.
caveats: Consumes more of model context space

features.name: MCP Proxy for Other Hosts
features.description: Sample code solution for routing requests and handling authentication when using MCP server with hosts other than Copilot Studio, available on BCTech samples as bcmcp proxy.
caveats: Only shipped as sample code, not production ready
Will be replaced by simpler solution in near future
Not a permanent part of Business Central product

features.name: Copilot Studio Support
features.description: Copilot Studio is the primary MCP host where the MCP server for Business Central journey started, with approximately 70 tools maximum supported.
caveats: Limit likely to change in future
